policy: Only source-labeled values; outstanding snapshot and historical diluted weighted average are not directly interchangeable

ADBE.name: Adobe
ADBE.capitalExpenditureDescription: 10-K reports capex without audited maintenance/growth split in the extracted standard series
ADBE.caveat: Spot shares after fiscal year close are not diluted weighted average; ASR settlement makes repurchase cash versus issued share movements asynchronous

INTU.name: Intuit
INTU.capitalExpenditureDescription: Filing historical capex without issuer-certified maintenance/growth split in the model
INTU.caveat: FY2026 treasury stock retirement changes issued-share accounting; do not mistake 233M treasury shares retired for 233M current buybacks

CPRT.name: Copart
CPRT.capitalExpenditureDescription: Land, opening and improving yards, software and facility equipment; maintenance/growth not quantitatively separated in cited text
CPRT.caveat: No post-ACV weighted-average or spot diluted share count confirmed; 2026 historical filing predates the transaction

ACV.financing: cash on hand and available cash resources, per ACV closing 8-K
ACV.note: Acquisition cash paid is not enterprise value and excludes unverified transaction expenses and assumed debt. Do not add NPV to standalone equity value without a reconciled post-deal bridge.
